worlds.name: Smoke Test Meadow
worlds.description: A small sunny meadow ringed by tall birch trees, soft golden late-afternoon light, wildflowers in the grass, a narrow dirt path winding through the middle, gentle mist in the distance
worlds.prompt: A small sunny meadow ringed by tall birch trees, soft golden late-afternoon light, wildflowers in the grass, a narrow dirt path winding through the middle, gentle mist in the distance
worlds.caption: The scene is a serene and idyllic meadow, rendered in a realistic style, bathed in the soft, golden light of a late afternoon. The overall tone is peaceful and enchanting, evoking a sense of natural beauty and tranquility. A small, sun-drenched meadow forms the central focus, its expanse covered in lush green grass. Numerous wildflowers in various hues of purple, yellow, and white are scattered throughout the grass, adding vibrant splashes of color to the verdant carpet. Tall, slender birch trees with their distinctive white bark ring the entire meadow, creating a natural, enclosing boundary. Their leaves, illuminated by the low-angle sunlight, exhibit a warm, golden-green glow. A narrow dirt path, well-worn and earthy brown, winds gently through the middle of the meadow, inviting exploration. In the distance, a gentle mist hangs subtly, softening the edges of the landscape and adding an ethereal quality to the scene. The birch trees stand closely together, forming a dense perimeter around the open meadow. The wildflowers are interspersed randomly among the blades of grass, creating a natural, uncultivated appearance. The dirt path meanders from one side of the meadow to the other, disappearing into the distant mist. The 360 scene is faultless.
